opus.problem: Nearly repeats clue 1. Both say the ark that held the tablets was made of this wood, so they are not 7 different facts. Also, the cited verse Deuteronomy 10:3 does not mention Moses breaking the first tablets or the chest being made to hold the new ones; that comes from Deuteronomy 10:1-2 and 10:5, so the clue is not fully true to its given verse. Replace it with a different fact, such as the acacia poles used to carry the ark or the acacia lands of the wilderness in Isaiah 41:19.
